Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

in a moment phrase

also in a minute, in a second, I’ll be right back

classical

Traupman 87

mōmentō temporis

Other words

  • jam — in a moment (with a future)

    adverb · also used · classical · Plaut. Cas. 526: jam hīc erō; Ter. Eun. 85: jam calēscēs; Traupman 88: soon (in a minute), jam

    The spoken way to say it: jam aderō, I’ll be there in a moment (Ter. Eun. 4.6.26, Lewis & Short; see coming); jam hīc erō, I’ll be back in a moment. Mōmentō temporis is the narrator’s phrase (Liv. 21.33, Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • cūrā, ego ad forum modo ībō: jam hīc erō. — Bene ambulā.

    Look after things; I’m just going to the forum: I’ll be back in a moment. — Have a good walk.Plaut. Cas. 526

See also any day now, just now, coming!, moment.

SourcesLewis & Short: momentum

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): pp. 87–88.
